policy: Where the owner's note on a relationship he removed or confirmed asks the record to say something no relationship row can hold, the record says it: what the texts disagree on and which reading is the more natural, what one verse leaves open and another settles, and which namesake a man is not.
source: Essenthos, on the project owner's notes on the review page of relationship facts, 2026-09-13 to 2026-09-16

says.notes: 1 Samuel 14:50-51 makes Kish, Saul's father, and Ner, Abner's father, both sons of Abiel, so that Ner was Saul's uncle and Abner his cousin, and 1 Samuel 9:1 calls Kish the son of Abiel. 1 Chronicles 8:33 and 9:39 read 'Ner begat Kish, and Kish begat Saul', which makes Ner Saul's grandfather and Abner his uncle. The reading of 1 Samuel is the more natural one and is the one Josephus gives; Chronicles keeps the other, twice, and no way of reconciling the two can be shown.

rulings.why: 'And the name of Saul's wife was Ahinoam': the king, whose family 14:50-51 sets out.

says.distinguisher: a woman of Moab, wife of Chilion (RUT 1:4, 4:10)
says.notes: Ruth 1:4 names the Moabite wives of Mahlon and Chilion without saying which was whose; Ruth 4:10 says that Ruth was the wife of Mahlon, so Orpah was Chilion's.

rulings.why: 'the name of the one was Orpah, and the name of the other Ruth': the verse does not say whose wife each was; Ruth 4:10 makes Ruth the wife of Mahlon.

says.notes: He is not Joseph's son Manasseh. The Hebrew of Judges 18:30 writes the name with its nun raised above the line, and read without it the name is Moses, whose son was Gershom (EXO 2:22).

rulings.why: 'Jonathan, the son of Gershom, the son of Manasseh, he and his sons were priests to the tribe of Dan'.

says.notes: A king's daughter, she wore the garment of divers colours that the king's daughters who were virgins wore (2SA 13:18). She is not Tamar, Judah's daughter-in-law (GEN 38).

rulings.why: 'Absalom the son of David had a fair sister, whose name was Tamar'.

says.distinguisher: wife of Hezron and mother of Ashur the father of Tekoa (1CH 2:24)
says.notes: Hezron married the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead when he was sixty (1CH 2:21). Whether Abiah is that daughter the text does not say.

rulings.why: 'then Abiah Hezron's wife bare him Ashur the father of Tekoa': the verse names her as Hezron's wife and does not say whose daughter she was.

says.notes: Jeroboam his son is called an Ephrathite of Zereda (1KI 11:26); of what tribe Nebat himself was the text does not say.

rulings.why: 'Jeroboam the son of Nebat, an Ephrathite of Zereda': the verse gives the son's people, not the father's.
